question: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q3 FY2027 earnings release? (Gross margin (GAAP))

calls.reasoning: On the Q2 FY27 call (Aug 26, 2026), CFO Kress explicitly said gross margins bottom in Q4 FY27 at 71-72% before recovering to 72-73% in FY28; the Q3 guide was 74.0% ±50bp (GAAP = non-GAAP). The Q4 guide given in the Q3 release should be near the 71.5% midpoint. Downside risk: memory prices described as 'extreme' and still rising, so the guide could slip to 71.0 or lower. Upside: NVIDIA has tended to meet or beat its own margin previews, and price increases are already executed, so 72.0 is plausible. GAAP has recently equaled non-GAAP. No human market found (Polymarket/Manifold none per the harness; no Kalshi or bookmaker contract found).
calls.dossier:
- Q2 FY27 (quarter ended Jul 26, 2026; reported Aug 26, 2026): revenue $96.2B; GAAP and non-GAAP GM both 75.0% (NVIDIA press release).
- Q3 FY27 outlook in that release: revenue $108.0B ±2%; GAAP and non-GAAP GM 74.0% ±50bp; no China data-center compute revenue assumed (NVIDIA press release, Aug 26, 2026).
- On the Aug 26 call, CFO Kress said margins are expected to bottom in Q4 FY27 in the 71%-72% range, then settle at 72%-73% in FY2028 as executed price increases take effect in Q1 FY28 (Webull, Lighthouse Canton and Benzinga recaps, Aug 2026).
- Kress cited 'extreme pricing conditions in memory'; the magnitude exceeded prior expectations and is 'heading higher into next year' (Lighthouse Canton; KuCoin news, Aug 2026).
- Supply commitments for critical components rose from $119B to $279B, mainly memory procurement (KuCoin/Benzinga, Aug 2026).
- Precedent: margins compressed during the Hopper-to-Blackwell ramp, then recovered (Lighthouse Canton).
- NVIDIA guides GM as a point ±50bp, usually at 0.5-pt granularity (e.g., 73.5, 74.0, 75.0); GAAP has equaled non-GAAP in recent FY27 quarters.
- Status quo: the guide follows management's stated Q4 trough range of 71-72%.
- Base rate over NVIDIA FY24-FY27: the next-quarter GM guide usually lands within about 1pt of the prior-quarter verbal preview; I found no systematic count.
- Resolves off the GAAP gross margin outlook in NVIDIA's Q3 FY27 earnings press release (expected about Nov 18-19, 2026), not the actual Q4 result.
- Event window: Q3 FY27 release date, scheduled resolution 2026-11-17 (criteria text blank); as of Oct 11, 2026 the release has not occurred.
- Searched but not found: the full transcript text (PDF unreadable), any update to margin outlook after Aug 26, and any Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold market on the GM guide.

calls.reconciliation: All three runs agree on the facts: Q3 guide 74.0% ±50bp, Q4 FY27 trough comment 71-72%, FY28 72-73%, GAAP≈non-GAAP, no market. Unsettled factual point: whether Kress's 71-72% was GAAP or non-GAAP (secondary reports silent); immaterial given 0-0.1pt recent gap. Judgment: downside tilt from rising memory costs vs NVIDIA's habit of meeting previews; I lean slightly low around a 71.5 mode and keep small open-bound tails (3% below, 1% above). Carried the runs' reference class forward; dispersion slightly tighter given an explicit one-quarter-ahead preview.
